description.value: Sophie's Cosmic Cafe has been a Kitsilano institution since 1988, serving comfort food classics like eggs Benedicts, burgers, club sandwiches, and legendary milkshakes from its colourful corner spot at 4th and Arbutus. The dining room is crammed with original artworks by notable Canadian artists—including Ken Lum and Fred Herzog—alongside vintage toys, metal lunch boxes, and shelves of collectibles. A small outdoor patio adds a welcoming street-level presence on one of Vancouver's busiest cycling corridors.
